title: T06f — First real lifecycle update on the Mac service
goal: Run one update through nodes lifecycle-inspect/apply on the owner-selected Mac and record the evidence
privacy: Neutral fixtures only in git; actual profiles, backups, credentials and deployment evidence remain private.
acceptance: The owner runs an update plan to a reviewed later revision; the receipt shows backup, fetch, rehearse, checkout, dependencies, build, start and verify completed
Running build, data integrity and service ownership are checked after it; a refusal or uncertainty is recorded, not retried silently
validation: Owner-run copy-paste commands with expected results; receipt and doctor output; acceptance note
escalation: Any destructive restore, changed ownership or unresolved physical/worker effects requires explicit reconciliation; general restore remains F-062

effort.basis: Owner-approved split of the original T06 (4–6 focused days) into lettered slices on 2026-11-11, after the work had been delivered as unplanned slices; slices e–h use free step numbers because step IDs are two digits. Needs a later reviewed revision to update to; the agent prepares commands, the owner runs them. Numbers backfilled 2026-11-11 at harness 5.4.0 from this estimate (rounded up to a quarter day); the baseline is this estimate, not an original one. Re-estimated 2026-11-11 in agent hours (harness 5.6.0): 0.75 hours agent + 0.5 hours owner; agent prepares and records the receipt; the owner runs the update on the Mac service. Method: NERV merge history (50 feature and fix PRs #140–#276, previous merge to merge: median 0.56 h, p75 2.1 h, p90 5.1 h) and B-046-T02 (2-day estimate, about 0.75 h stated to implement) put a focused day at about 1.5 agent hours, with 0.75 h the least for one PR with review and CI. Estimate, not a measurement; baselineDays 0.5 kept as history.
